name: Argos Nightwhisper
summary: In Stormwind's Park, Argos Nightwhisper guides Alliance travelers toward Darkshore. His brother Gershala studies the corruption spreading there.

sections.title: A Kaldorei in the Human Capital
sections.body: Argos Nightwhisper lives among the night elves gathering in Stormwind's Park. The district's quiet groves recall the kaldorei's ancestral woodlands. Like others of his kin stationed in the human kingdom, Argos connects the new allies across the Great Sea. Reports from across the ocean trouble him. He urges capable Alliance champions to travel to Auberdine in Darkshore, where his brother Gershala needs help against the spreading corruption.

faq.answer: Argos Nightwhisper is a night elf who lives in Stormwind City. He represents Darnassus in the eastern Alliance capital, helping travelers and directing them to passage to Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where can Argos Nightwhisper be found?
faq.answer: You can find Argos in the Park, Stormwind City's green district where visiting night elves gather.

faq.q: What does Argos ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Argos asks seasoned adventurers to travel to Auberdine in Darkshore, where his brother Gershala needs help studying the corruption spreading through the land.

faq.q: Is Argos related to other Nightwhispers?
faq.answer: Yes. Argos is the brother of Gershala Nightwhisper, a night elf scholar in Auberdine in Darkshore. That is why Argos sends travelers there.

angles.text: As a kaldorei far from Kalimdor, you may find Argos a familiar face. He points travelers toward his brother in Darkshore and the threats endangering their homeland.
As an Alliance hero, you can look to Argos as a link between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. He encourages young heroes to cross the sea and aid the night elves.
